alerts.title: Web Shell Upload & Execution Detected (DVWA / Unrestricted Upload)
alerts.description: Detected 3 HTTP requests indicating upload and execution of a PHP web shell (e.g. backdoor.php) from 10.0.10.254 on web-server.
evidence: 10.0.10.254 - - [18/Apr/2023:12:44:12 +0000] "POST /hackable/uploads/backdoor.php HTTP/1.1" 200 4820
10.0.10.254 - - [18/Apr/2023:12:51:40 +0000] "POST /hackable/uploads/backdoor.php HTTP/1.1" 200 2190
remediation: Isolate the web server and remove malicious PHP scripts from the uploads directory.
Ensure Apache is NOT compiled with -DBIG_SECURITY_HOLE and does not run as root.
Disable PHP execution (php_flag engine off) inside user upload directories.

alerts.title: SSH Brute-Force Followed by Successful Login
alerts.description: Detected 5 failed SSH login attempts from 10.0.10.254 against web-server, followed by 2 successful login(s).
evidence: Apr 18 12:35:01 web-server sshd[2104]: Failed password for invalid user admin from 10.0.10.254 port 49112 ssh2
Apr 18 12:35:04 web-server sshd[2106]: Failed password for root from 10.0.10.254 port 49118 ssh2
Apr 18 12:35:07 web-server sshd[2109]: Failed password for root from 10.0.10.254 port 49124 ssh2
Apr 18 12:52:09 web-server sshd[2341]: Accepted publickey for root from 10.0.10.254 port 50214 ssh2: RSA SHA256:kali@kali
Apr 19 08:11:18 web-server sshd[4102]: Accepted publickey for root from 10.0.10.254 port 54110 ssh2: RSA SHA256:kali@kali
remediation: Block the offending source IP via firewall / Fail2ban.
Audit /root/.ssh/authorized_keys for unauthorized SSH keys (e.g. kali@kali).
Disable PermitRootLogin in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.

alerts.title: Windows RDP/Network Brute-Force Attack (Event ID 4625 -> 4624)
alerts.target_user: ivanov, kuznecov, petrov, popov, sidorov, smirnov
alerts.description: Detected 6 failed Windows logon attempts (Event ID 4625) from 10.0.30.55 (WorkstationName: unknown) on windows-host.
evidence: {"EventID": "4625", "TimeCreated": "2023-04-18 12:50:12", "TargetUserName": "ivanov", "IpAddress": "10.0.30.55", "ServiceName": "", "TicketEncryptionType": ""}
{"EventID": "4625", "TimeCreated": "2023-04-18 12:50:12", "TargetUserName": "petrov", "IpAddress": "10.0.30.55", "ServiceName": "", "TicketEncryptionType": ""}
{"EventID": "4625", "TimeCreated": "2023-04-18 12:50:12", "TargetUserName": "sidorov", "IpAddress": "10.0.30.55", "ServiceName": "", "TicketEncryptionType": ""}
remediation: Enforce Account Lockout Policy in Active Directory GPO.
Restrict RDP access by IP and require Network Level Authentication (NLA) + MFA.
Rotate compromised user credentials immediately.

alerts.title: Windows RDP/Network Brute-Force Attack (Event ID 4625 -> 4624)
alerts.description: Detected 5 failed Windows logon attempts (Event ID 4625) from 10.0.10.5 (WorkstationName: kali) on ws01.acme.skb, followed by 1 successful logon(s) (Event ID 4624).
evidence: An account failed to log on. Account: user1, Source Network Address: 10.0.10.5, Workstation Name: kali (Brute-RDP.py attempt 1/28)
An account failed to log on. Account: user1, Source Network Address: 10.0.10.5, Workstation Name: kali (Brute-RDP.py attempt 6/28)
An account failed to log on. Account: user1, Source Network Address: 10.0.10.5, Workstation Name: kali (Brute-RDP.py attempt 12/28)
An account was successfully logged on via RDP (LogonType 10). Account: ACME\user1, Source IP: 10.0.10.5 (SSH Tunnel from kali)
remediation: Enforce Account Lockout Policy in Active Directory GPO.
Restrict RDP access by IP and require Network Level Authentication (NLA) + MFA.
Rotate compromised user credentials immediately.

alerts.title: Kerberoasting Attack Detected (RC4-HMAC TGS Request - Event ID 4769)
alerts.mitre_technique: T1558.003 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting)
alerts.description: Detected 1 Kerberos TGS ticket request(s) (Event ID 4769) using legacy RC4-HMAC encryption (0x17) targeting service accounts for offline cracking.
evidence: A Kerberos service ticket was requested (Event ID 4769). Service Name: mssql_svc, Ticket Encryption Type: 0x17 (RC4-HMAC), Client Address: 10.0.30.53
remediation: Migrate service accounts to Group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA) with 240-char passwords.
Enforce AES128/AES256 Kerberos encryption and disable RC4-HMAC in Domain Policy.

alerts.title: Pass-the-Hash (PtH) Lateral Movement Detected (Event ID 4624 NTLM)
alerts.mitre_technique: T1550.002 (Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Hash)
alerts.description: Detected 1 NTLM network logon(s) (LogonType 3, NtLmSsp, KeyLength=0) to dc01.acme.skb as 'domainadmin' from 10.0.30.53, characteristic of Pass-the-Hash.
evidence: Pass-the-Hash detected (Wazuh Rule 92652): Account domainadmin logged on to dc01.acme.skb from 10.0.30.53 using NTLM (LogonType 3, NtLmSsp, KeyLength=0).
remediation: Add privileged accounts to the Active Directory 'Protected Users' security group.
Enable Windows Defender Credential Guard (LSA Protection / RunAsPPL) on all domain hosts.
Reset KRBTGT and privileged domain account passwords twice.

alerts.title: Security Monitoring / Windows Defender Tampering Detected
alerts.mitre_technique: T1562.001 (Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools)
alerts.description: Detected disabling of Microsoft Defender Real-Time Protection (Event ID 5001/5007) and/or termination of the Wazuh SIEM agent service.
evidence: Apr 19 10:15:09 web-server systemd[1]: Stopping Wazuh agent...
Apr 19 10:15:10 web-server wazuh-agent[1120]: Stopped Wazuh agent (Rule 506).
Microsoft Defender Antivirus Real-Time Protection scanning for malware and other potentially unwanted software was disabled.
remediation: Enable Tamper Protection in Microsoft Defender and enforce settings via GPO.
Configure immediate high-priority SOC escalation on Wazuh Rule 506 (Agent stopped).

alerts.title: Forensic Artifact: Deleted LPE Exploit Detected via WER AppCrash
alerts.mitre_technique: T1068 (Exploitation for Privilege Escalation) / T1070.004 (File Deletion)
alerts.description: Windows Error Reporting (WER Event ID 1001) recorded an application crash matching a known privilege escalation exploit (e.g. CVE-2019-0623.exe), proving execution even if the attacker subsequently deleted the binary.
evidence: Fault bucket, type 0. Event Name: APPCRASH. Application Name: CVE-2019-0623.exe. Report archive: C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportArchive\AppCrash_CVE-2019-0623.ex_8051a89bf9be3b7c258b25fbbf6b2aa10ef12a6_5625ce51_068f0915-7e50-45f3-b91e-2662535e4f58
remediation: Preserve C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportArchive\ for forensic analysis.
Apply cumulative Windows kernel security updates (Win32k LPE patches).

alerts.title: Malware / Mimikatz Execution via Redirected RDP Drive (\\tsclient)
alerts.description: Microsoft Defender logged 2 malware/hacktool detection(s) (including HackTool:Win32/Mimikatz.D and Trojan:Win32/Sabsik.TE.A!ml). UNC path analysis reveals execution directly from an attacker-mounted RDP shared drive (\\tsclient\...), exposing the attacker host filesystem.
evidence: Microsoft Defender Antivirus has detected malware: Trojan:Win32/Sabsik.TE.A!ml. Path: file:_C:\Users\Public\Documents\CVEs\cve-2019-1458.exe
Microsoft Defender Antivirus has detected malware or potentially unwanted software: HackTool:Win32/Mimikatz.D. Path: file:_\\tsclient\_home_kali_Documents_Brute-RDP.py_rdpshare_\mimikatz.exe
remediation: Disable RDP Drive Redirection via GPO (Do not allow drive redirection).
Isolate affected workstation and rotate all domain credentials cached in LSASS.
